show.description: A young man sets out to lay his father’s ashes at the ancestral grave, but destiny pulls him into a storm of secrets and betrayal. Along the way, he meets a fierce girl whose father was branded a traitor. As truth unfolds, a ruthless martial artist rises to seize Qingi. Bound by love, honor, and legacy, the young warrior must face his greatest trial — to protect his people and accept his destiny as the next clan leader.
